summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi IREN 2x Daily ETF (IREC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of IREN Ltd. (NASDAQ: IREN), through derivatives such as swaps IREC was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
